description:
Deployment-tunable knobs of ``dataset/decontam`` (ADR-0070) — the near-dup
overlap parameters. **Operational** scope (the default): a workflow/run may
tune these freely. A subset of ``DecontamInput``; the safe defaults live on
``DecontamInput``.

overlap_threshold.description: Jaccard similarity (0-1) at/above which a train row is flagged as near-dup contamination.
overlap_threshold.title: Contamination overlap threshold

num_perm.description: MinHash signature length — higher is more accurate but slower (minhash).
num_perm.title: MinHash permutations

title: DecontamConfig
